camel_example: aliyun linkwan ListActivatedFeatures --region cn-hangzhou --Environment IotInstance --version 2019-03-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Lists the features available to the current user account in Alibaba Cloud Link WAN
description_zh: 列举当前用户账号在物联网络管理平台所能使用的功能
name: ListActivatedFeatures

parameters.help_en: The current call environment. Default value: empty, which indicates a public instance. If the environment is an instantiated IoT Platform environment, set this parameter to IotInstance
parameters.help_zh: 当前的调用环境，默认为空，表示公共实例，如果是物联网平台实例化环境，请传入“IotInstance”
parameters.name: environment

items.description_en:
The list of features available to the current user account in Alibaba Cloud Link WAN. Valid values:
GATEWAY_TUPLE: gateway key management
NODE_TUPLE: node key management
NODE: node management
GATEWAY: gateway management
LOCAL_JOIN_PERMISSION: local credential management
ROAMING_JOIN_PERMISSION: roaming credential management
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTHORIZATION: credential permission authorization
LAB_NODE: lab node
LAB_GATEWAY: lab gateway
NOTIFICATION: notification
UNICAST: unicast command downstream
MULTICAST: multicast command downstream
RELAY: relay management
D2D: peer-to-peer communication
items.description_zh:
当前用户账号在物联网络管理平台所能使用的功能的列表。

    GATEWAY_TUPLE：网关密钥管理功能

    NODE_TUPLE：节点密钥管理功能

    NODE：节点管理功能

    GATEWAY：网关管理功能

    LOCAL_JOIN_PERMISSION：本地凭证管理功能

    ROAMING_JOIN_PERMISSION：漫游凭证管理功能

    JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTHORIZATION：凭证权限授受能力

    LAB_NODE：实验室节点功能

    LAB_GATEWAY：实验室网关功能

    NOTIFICATION：通知功能

    UNICAST：单播指令下行功能

    MULTICAST：组播指令下行功能

    RELAY：中继管理功能

    D2D：点对点通信能力

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
